description: This Java class 'GrantRevokeIndex' manages an index of granted and revoked permissions for subjects, providing methods to check permissions, retrieve affected subjects, and mutate the index.

classes.name: GrantRevokeIndex
classes.description: Final class that maintains mappings of granted and revoked permissions for subjects, with methods for permission checks and index mutation.

methods.name: GrantRevokeIndex
methods.description: Constructor initializing empty or provided grant and revoke maps.

methods.name: getGranted
methods.description: Returns the map of granted permissions.

methods.name: getRevoked
methods.description: Returns the map of revoked permissions.

methods.name: copyWithDecrementedWeight
methods.description: Returns a new index with each permission-subject pair weight decreased by 1.

methods.name: overrideBy
methods.description: Mutates the index by overriding with another index's grant and revoke entries.

methods.name: hasPermissions
methods.description: Checks if permissions are granted to subjects without being revoked.

methods.name: getEffectedSubjectIds
methods.description: Deprecated method returning subjects with all permissions granted and some revoked.

methods.name: getEffectedSubjects
methods.description: Returns subjects for whom all permissions are granted and some are revoked.

methods.name: getGrantedSubjectIds
methods.description: Deprecated method returning IDs of subjects with granted permissions.

methods.name: getGrantedSubjects
methods.description: Returns AuthorizationSubject objects for granted subjects.

methods.name: getRevokedSubjectIds
methods.description: Deprecated method returning IDs of subjects with revoked permissions.

methods.name: getRevokedSubjects
methods.description: Returns AuthorizationSubject objects for revoked subjects.
